description: Fork of exp208 (E=192, val_bpb=2.02 @ 1000). Single change: Q and K head dim 32 -> 64 (V stays at E_H=32 so heads concat -> E=192). Hypothesis: with smaller E the QK rank-32 attention is starved; larger qk_dim restores per-head discrimination without changing the residual stream width. Wq/Wk shape [H, D, 64], Wv shape [H, D, 32].
